wSF82AwSDiU.title: The great porn experiment | Gary Wilson | TEDxGlasgow
wSF82AwSDiU.summary: Gary Wilson's TEDxGlasgow talk argues that internet pornography hyperstimulates the brain's reward system and can cause symptoms that reverse when people stop. TED notes that several claims are not supported by respected academic studies.
wSF82AwSDiU.sz: Gary Wilson 在 TEDxGlasgow 演讲中主张网络色情会过度刺激大脑奖励系统，并导致可逆的症状，停止观看后可恢复。TED 备注其中部分论点缺乏权威学术支持。
wSF82AwSDiU.why: HN commenters frequently recommend it as an eye-opening case against heavy porn use, though it is contested science.
wSF82AwSDiU.wz: HN 常推荐它作为对重度色情使用的警示案例，尽管其科学性有争议。

quote.text: Here's an enlightening video on the detrimental effects of porn on the brain.

sWblpsLZ-O8.title: A Mind Is Born (256 bytes)
sWblpsLZ-O8.summary: A Commodore 64 demo by Linus Akesson that fits video and music into 256 bytes, winning the Oldskool 4K Intro compo at Revision 2017. A technical write-up accompanies it.
sWblpsLZ-O8.why: It is HN's favorite example of extreme code compression, a compelling song and visuals from a program smaller than a tweet.

quote.text: not only because it is 256 bytes, but because it is a compelling song too.

pgoetgxecw8.title: Refterm Lecture Part 1 - Philosophies of Optimization
pgoetgxecw8.summary: Casey Muratori's first refterm lecture lays out philosophies of optimization, distinguishing optimization from non-pessimization, which means avoiding needless work. It uses his fast terminal renderer project to show how fast computers really are.
pgoetgxecw8.why: HN returns to it constantly in software performance debates as the primer on non-pessimization and why modern software is slow.

quote.text: The video on Philosophies of Optimisation is a good primer on the tenets of the course.

wM8Xli2KTzI.title: Why Electric Bikes are More Dangerous than Motorcycles
wM8Xli2KTzI.summary: FortNine argues that e-bikes have injury rates and speeds closer to motorcycles than to pedal bikes. It argues riders should treat them with similar safety gear and caution.
wM8Xli2KTzI.why: Cited repeatedly in e-bike threads as a well-argued safety counterpoint from someone who rides both.

quote.text: Fortnine made an excellent argument against the safety of ebikes, worth watching as a rebuttal to this article

PE4gwstWhmc.title: How We've Scaled Dropbox
PE4gwstWhmc.summary: Dropbox engineer Kevin Modzelewski gives a Stanford colloquium on Dropbox's history and the technical problems it faced scaling, including detailed database schema decisions.
PE4gwstWhmc.why: Recommended as a detailed, candid case study of scaling a real system from zero users to millions.

quote.text: I found the Dropbox lecture [1] at Stanford one of the most riveting things ever.

qybUFnY7Y8w.title: OK Go - This Too Shall Pass - Rube Goldberg Machine - Official Video
qybUFnY7Y8w.summary: OK Go's music video for This Too Shall Pass, featuring a huge Rube Goldberg machine built in a warehouse in Los Angeles with Syyn Labs. The band interacts with the contraption in one continuous take.
qybUFnY7Y8w.why: HN points to it as an example of ambitious, practical-effects creativity in music videos, made without CGI.

quote.text: The Rube Goldberg machine [0] one is particularily impressive.

NP9AIUT9nos.title: Lone Star Ruby Conference 2010 Real Software Engineering by Glenn Vanderburg
NP9AIUT9nos.summary: Glenn Vanderburg argues at Lone Star Ruby Conference 2010 that university-style software engineering does not work, and asks what real software engineering would look like. He revisits the waterfall model and what engineering means in other fields.
NP9AIUT9nos.why: HN recommends it for changing minds about whether programmers can be called engineers, and for its take on how waterfall was misread.

quote.text: I always thought calling programmers engineers was very weird until I watched this great talk

2THVvshvq0Q.title: Michael Bay - What is Bayhem?
2THVvshvq0Q.summary: An Every Frame a Painting video essay on Michael Bay's style, 'Bayhem', covering his camera movement, composition, color and editing. It argues that even if you dislike his films, they teach something about visual perception.
2THVvshvq0Q.why: HN recommends it as a short, well-produced and eye-opening piece of film analysis.

quote.text: short, easily digestible, and well-produced YouTube videos about this stuff that are eye-opening.

AxCo2bE9Gtk.title: Republic, Lost (my favorite version)
AxCo2bE9Gtk.summary: Lawrence Lessig's 2011 Berkeley book talk based on Republic, Lost, arguing that money in politics creates institutional corruption in Congress. He calls it his favorite version of the talk.
AxCo2bE9Gtk.why: HN people point to it as a starting place for understanding how money corrupts American government.

quote.text: Lawrence Lessig has some great talks about this topic, here's one of them

7pSqk-XV2QM.title: How Kodak Exposed Nuclear Testing
7pSqk-XV2QM.summary: Veritasium tells how Kodak film was fogged by radioactive fallout from the first atomic tests, letting the company detect nuclear testing before anyone announced it. The video also covers the deal to keep it quiet and how fallout contaminated packaging.
7pSqk-XV2QM.why: HN commenters bring it up as a good related watch in any thread about fallout, nuclear tests or detecting hidden events through indirect evidence.

quote.text: Veritasium did an eye opening vid on how fallout blew across the country and was ruining Kodak's film on the East Coast.

Pae2AMnmUVA.title: PAUL TAYLOR - #FRANGLAIS - FULL SHOW
Pae2AMnmUVA.summary: Paul Taylor's first stand-up special, recorded in Paris in 2018, in which a British comedian living in France riffs on French culture, language and bureaucracy. It is the full 70-minute show.
Pae2AMnmUVA.why: Recommended as hilarious for anyone familiar with both French and British or American culture, and relevant to expats.

quote.text: I HIGHLY recommend a watch, it's hilarious especially if you're familiar with both French and British/American culture

FzF1KySHmUA.title: For the undying 9/11 MORONIC JET FUEL ARGUMENT
FzF1KySHmUA.summary: A short video from a blacksmith, who heats and bends steel to rebut the claim that jet fuel could not weaken the steel in the World Trade Center. It is delivered with a lot of attitude.
FzF1KySHmUA.why: HN commenters use it as a quick, hands-on demonstration that steel loses strength well below its melting point.

quote.text: watch this excellent and short video from a blacksmith

lfo8XHGFAIQ.title: Can We Terraform the Sahara to Stop Climate Change?
lfo8XHGFAIQ.tz: 我们能改造撒哈拉拯救气候吗？
lfo8XHGFAIQ.summary: Real Engineering examines whether greening the Sahara could draw down carbon and slow climate change. It concludes that the effort would be enormously costly and that changes in albedo and other effects undercut the climate benefit.
lfo8XHGFAIQ.sz: Real Engineering 探讨了通过绿化撒哈拉来吸收碳、减缓气候变化的设想。结果显示该工程成本极高，且反照率等效应会抵消大部分气候收益。
lfo8XHGFAIQ.why: Recommended in tree-planting and carbon removal threads as a sourced explanation of why greening deserts is not a simple climate fix.
lfo8XHGFAIQ.wz: 在植树和碳移除讨论中，被推荐为对荒漠绿化并非简单气候解决方案的可靠解释。

quote.text: I recommend watching the video - it explains it better and goes into detail - it cites its own sources.

4LqZdkkBDas.title: Jordan Peterson | ContraPoints

LHvR1fRTW8g.title: Hitting the Sun is HARD
